assessments.note: after fix (ppm-092/1, u06): The card asks who the subject of The Scream is; the fact asked for the 'infinite scream' quote instead. By Munch's own notes the scene is his own experience on a walk with two friends, so the answer is Munch himself; the Munch Museum stresses the figure isn't a literal self-portrait (nature screams), so the wording asks whose experience it depicts.
